etymologies.heading: Etymology
paragraphs: From pains +‎ taking; see take pains. The /ˈpeɪnˌsteɪkɪŋ/ pronunciation which dominates in the United States suggests a reanalysis of the word as pain +‎ staking.
senses: Carefully attentive to details; studious; diligent in performing a process or procedure.
The application of careful and attentive effort.
